title: Multiply in place
prompt: A member `speed` starts at 10. A `boost` helper triples it, and speed_after_boost boosts once and reports 30.
hints: boost multiplies speed by 3 with `*=`, which multiplies a variable and stores the result back; speed_after_boost calls boost and returns speed.

docs.name: a * b
docs.what: Multiplies two numbers. * with a float keeps decimals.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.
